title: A cell-free assay implicates a role of sphingomyelin and cholesterol in STING phosphorylation.
authors: Takahashi, Kanoko; Niki, Takahiro; Ogawa, Emari; Fumika, Kiku; Nishioka, Yu; Sawa, Masaaki; Arai, Hiroyuki; Mukai, Kojiro; Taguchi, Tomohiko
one_liner_zh: 该文研究STING磷酸化的无细胞实验体系，涉及脂质作用，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: Stimulator of interferon genes (STING) is essential for the type I interferon response induced by microbial DNA from virus or self-DNA from mitochondria/nuclei. In response to emergence of such DNAs in the cytosol, STING translocates from the endoplasmic reticulum to the Golgi, and activates TANK-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) at the trans-Golgi network (TGN). Activated TBK1 then phosphorylates STING at Ser365, generating an interferon regulatory factor 3-docking site on STING. How this reaction proceeds specifically at the TGN remains poorly understood. Here we report a cell-free reaction in which endogenous STING is phosphorylated by TBK1. The reaction utilizes microsomal membrane fraction prepared from TBK1-knockout cells and recombinant TBK1. We observed agonist-, TBK1-, "ER-to-Golgi" traffic-, and palmitoylation-dependent phosphorylation of STING at Ser365, mirroring the nature of STING phosphorylation in vivo. Treating the microsomal membrane fraction with sphingomyelinase or methyl-beta-cyclodextrin, an agent to extract cholesterol from membranes, suppressed the phosphorylation of STING by TBK1. Given the enrichment of sphingomyelin and cholesterol in the TGN, these results may provide the molecular basis underlying the specific phosphorylation reaction of STING at the TGN.
abstract_zh: 干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）对于由病毒微生物DNA或线粒体/细胞核自身DNA诱导的I型干扰素反应至关重要。当这些DNA出现在细胞质中时，STING从内质网转位至高尔基体，并在反式高尔基体网络（trans-Golgi network, TGN）处激活TANK结合激酶1（TANK-binding kinase 1, TBK1）。随后，激活的TBK1在Ser365位点磷酸化STING，在STING上生成干扰素调节因子3对接位点。这一反应如何在TGN处特异性地进行仍知之甚少。在此，我们报告了一种无细胞反应，其中内源性STING被TBK1磷酸化。该反应利用了从TBK1敲除细胞制备的微粒体膜组分和重组TBK1。我们观察到STING在Ser365位点的磷酸化依赖于激动剂、TBK1、“内质网到高尔基体”运输以及棕榈酰化，这反映了体内STING磷酸化的特性。用鞘磷脂酶或甲基-β-环糊精（一种从膜中提取胆固醇的试剂）处理微粒体膜组分，抑制了TBK1对STING的磷酸化。鉴于鞘磷脂和胆固醇在TGN中的富集，这些结果可能为STING在TGN处特异性磷酸化反应提供分子基础。
